mission.title: ollama: Adding support for amd new GPUS 9070 and 9070 XT
mission.description: Adding support for amd new GPUS 9070 and 9070 XT. Requested by 69+ users.

steps.title: Check current ollama setup
steps.description:
Verify your ollama version and configuration:
```bash
ollama --version
```
This feature requires a working ollama installation.

steps.title: Review ollama configuration
steps.description:
Review the relevant ollama configuration:
Would like to add support for AMD new GPUS 9070 and 9070 XT, as they are both unsupported / unrecognized as  gfx1201

steps.title: Apply the fix for Adding support for amd new GPUS 9070 and 9070 XT
steps.description:
Thank you for sharing this, I wasn't aware about the project, so given it a try. 

I didn't uninstall original Ollama, just installed Ollama for AMD into different directory (using /DIR=D:\..... key), replaced libraries as instructed and linked models library to newly installed Ollama.

I have 2
